game_title: Loop Counter Conveyor – Hidden Spring Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring, a hidden spring: the cave miner must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Hidden Spring: a hidden spring
core_gameplay_loop: In Hidden Spring, repeat each round: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed. Each round, a new crystal shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the belt_count value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 240 points of crystal shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 240, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Loop Counter Conveyor
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
